callouts.text: The numbers in this example come from a small synthetic test file, not from live data. A live answer names the real weeks sampled and the date from which killmails are counted.
callouts.title: Example numbers

prompt: How busy is Tama usually on Tuesday evenings at 19:00 UTC?

result.text:
Tama, Tuesday 19:00-20:00 UTC, usual activity (5 weeks sampled):
- jumps: mean 412, sd 41 (n 5)
- ship kills: mean 9.4, sd 3.2 (n 5)
- pod kills: mean 3.0, sd 0.7 (n 5)
- NPC kills: mean 0.8, sd 0.8 (n 5)
- PvP killmails on zKillboard: mean 8.6, sd 1.8 (n 5); mean ISK destroyed 1.42b
Hours the collector missed are left out, not counted as zero. Jumps are gate jumps only.
PvP killmails counted since 2026-10-05 (UTC). Sample standard deviation; the latest hour is not part of the usual numbers.
